Do the analysis in R and leave a figure and a table of the numbers in results/ so I can look at them.

steps.text:
Both quorum-sensing systems matter: every single mutant swarmed far less than wild type, and losing the rhl system hurt about twice as much as losing las.

**Colony area** (wild-type geometric mean 81,732 imaging units; arithmetic mean 82,442 ± 13,203):

| Genotype | System | Area ratio vs WT (95% CI) | Change | Holm p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ΔlasI | las | 0.27 (0.13–0.57) | −73% | 0.016 |
| ΔlasR | las | 0.29 (0.16–0.50) | −72% | 0.016 |
| ΔrhlI | rhl | 0.15 (0.063–0.34) | −85% | 0.016 |
| rhlR- | rhl | 0.13 (0.091–0.19) | −87% | 0.0035 |

Pooling the two mutants of each system, rhl mutant colonies were half the area of las mutant colonies (ratio 0.50, 95% CI 0.35–0.71, p = 0.0015).

**Shape.** Circularity rose 5.2–8.2× above wild type (0.076 → 0.40–0.62; all Holm p ≤ 0.002), so mutant colonies are much less irregular/dendritic, though still not circular (highest single dish 0.71). Roundness did not change consistently (wild type 0.886; mutants 0.788–0.975; all Holm p ≥ 0.41), so the change is in perimeter irregularity rather than elongation.

**Caveat.** There are only three dishes per genotype. The exact rank test cannot go below p = 0.1 for 3 vs 3, so the inference rests on Welch tests on log area/circularity with Holm adjustment within each metric. Under the strictest correction across all 12 comparisons, ΔlasI area becomes borderline (Holm p = 0.063); every circularity result stays significant. Group variances were homogeneous on the analysed scales (Levene p ≥ 0.32), and pooled-variance t-tests give the same conclusions.

Files:
- [analysis/swarming_single_mutants.R](analysis/swarming_single_mutants.R) — the R analysis; runs standalone with `Rscript analysis/swarming_single_mutants.R` from the project root.
- [results/swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv](results/swarming_single_mutants_summary.csv) — the table of numbers (means, SDs, ratios/differences, 95% CIs, adjusted p).
- [results/swarming_system_contrast.csv](results/swarming_system_contrast.csv) — rhl vs las mutants.
- [results/swarming_single_mutants.png](results/swarming_single_mutants.png) — three-panel figure (area, circularity, roundness), also embedded in the project notes.
